evidence_policy.note: Benchmark rows are capability evidence, not automatic proof of an entire broad family. Promotion scope may not exceed measured or directly supported behavior.

families.useful_behavior: Long-running work in unfamiliar/large codebases: feature implementation, debugging, refactoring, review, terminal operation, ambiguous multi-file changes, root-cause analysis and self-checking.
Plan and execute complex multi-tool work, coordinate subagents, maintain state and drive long-running work with minimal oversight.
Produce high-quality professional work products and complete multi-hour/multi-stage office tasks.
Execute real multi-application business workflows accurately end-to-end.
Solve difficult expert-level questions across domains with search/code/tools.
Use scientific software, tools, analysis and iterative reasoning to solve long-horizon research/technical tasks.
Read and reason over dense documents, charts, screenshots, diagrams and complex real-world imagery.
Complete multi-step workflows across browsers and arbitrary applications with planning, visual grounding and judgment.

public_bars.comparison_warning: Published Astra OSWorld result uses a different evaluation setup; do not compare directly.

families.useful_behavior: Read filings/models/charts, maintain deal/reporting context, reason precisely and handle compliance-sensitive nuance.
Follow complex instructions, stay within authorization/scope, resolve routine ambiguity and adapt when requirements change.
Use memory across sessions, preserve project state and resume long-running work coherently.
Delegate to multiple workers/subagents, coordinate results and check delegated work.
Check work creatively, falsify conclusions, diagnose failures and recover without losing the goal.
Create professional spreadsheets, slides, documents, reports, code and other immediately usable artifacts.
Communicate clearly, prioritize what matters, follow writing rules and synthesize complex work over long sessions.
Find, select, learn and correctly use tools/software/APIs/solvers required for unfamiliar work.
Enter unfamiliar domains, learn ontology/tools and become effective without prior human teaching.
Compose reasoning, research, tools, code, memory, actions and verification into one causal execution system.
For the bounded verified operation classes in OBS-EXACT-SYMBOLIC-001, compute objective symbolic results exactly and deterministically without relying on frontier-model internal reasoning.

absolute_bar.definition: 100% exact correctness on frozen bounded task class OBS-EXACT-SYMBOLIC-001

families.scope_warning: Does not claim general mathematical reasoning, theorem proving, scientific reasoning, word-problem reasoning, or symbolic operations outside the frozen suite classes.

acceptance_closure_note: Every family must terminate in a complete behavioral contract and one admissible proof mode: theoretical ceiling/formal proof, exhaustive finite verification, or predeclared matched statistical comparison against the Opus 5.5 bar. Broad prose alone is not terminal acceptance.
